title: switch-case Statement
concept: The switch statement compares one value against multiple cases to branch, and the role of break

steps.title: Starting main function
steps.explanation:
**`int main() {`** -- The entry point of the program, and a main stack frame is created on the stack.

In this lesson, we learn the **switch-case statement**.

steps.title: Initializing the day variable
steps.explanation: **`int day = 3;`** -- Declares an integer variable `day` and initializes it to **3**. By convention, 1 means Monday, 2 means Tuesday, and 3 means Wednesday.

steps.title: Entering the switch statement
steps.explanation: **`switch (day) {`** -- Compares the value inside the parentheses (`day = 3`) with each case value from top to bottom. When a matching case is found, execution starts from that point.

steps.title: case 3 matches - output
steps.explanation: **`printf("Wednesday\n");`** -- The value of `day` (**3**) matched `case 3:`, so switch jumps to this point and executes the code. `Wednesday` is printed to the screen.

steps.title: Exiting switch with break
steps.explanation: **`break;`** -- The escape command that **immediately exits** the switch statement. When break is encountered, execution jumps directly to the line after switch's closing `}`.

steps.title: Program termination
steps.explanation: **`return 0;`** -- After exiting the switch, the program terminates normally. As main's stack frame is deallocated, `day` also disappears from memory.

quiz.explanation:
Without break, fall-through occurs.
Execution starts at case 1 and continues through all code below (case 2, case 3, default) consecutively.
Therefore A, B, C, and D are all printed.

misconceptions.wrong: switch only executes the matching case
misconceptions.correct: Without break, execution continues from the matched case through all code below (fall-through).
misconceptions.why: switch only 'jumps' to the matching case; it does not stop automatically. break is the explicit termination signal.

keyTakeaway: switch jumps to the matching case, and without break it falls through to all cases below.
